mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inv_stock WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 AND qty > 0 ORDER BY last_in_date

SELECT product_id, product_code, product_name, spec, p_safety_stock, qty, available_qty, wh_name, warehouse_name, (p_safety_stock - qty) AS shortage FROM ( SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.spec, p.safety_stock AS p_safety_stock, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.available_qty), 0) AS available_qty, MIN(w.warehouse_name) AS wh_name, MIN(s.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name FROM base_product p LEFT JOIN inv_stock s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.safety_stock > 0 GROUP BY p.id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.spec, p.safety_stock ) t WHERE qty < p_safety_stock ORDER BY shortage DESC
